```python
import subprocess

cmds = [
    "find /opt/abb-sdk-repo/.kuma -maxdepth 4 2>/dev/null",
    "grep -rIl -E 'increment|decrement|replica|partition' /opt/abb-sdk-repo 2>/dev/null | grep -v -E 'site-packages|\\.git/' | head -30",
    "find / -xdev -iname '*serve*' -o -iname '*service*' 2>/dev/null | grep -v -E 'site-packages|/usr/(lib|share)|/proc|/sys|dist-packages' | head -40",
    "ls -la /opt/agent 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; find /opt/agent -maxdepth 2 2>/dev/null | head -40",
]
for c in cmds:
    print("="*70); print("$", c)
    r = subprocess.run(c, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print((r.stdout or "(no output)")[:4000])
    if r.stderr.strip(): print("ERR:", r.stderr[:300])
```
